messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to eu1: service/inference v2.20.1 -> v2.21.0 (rollout 15%) commit d34db33f. automated canary checks initially green.

kevin: FYI synth probes started reporting intermittent timeouts to /v1/generate in eu1 ~+70s after wheels up. probes return 524 (timeout) rather than 5xx; looks like tail latency.

tara: On it. Can anyone share the canary p95 and error-rate graph for the last 5m?

sre-lee: p95 jumped from 420ms to ~1.9s at ~+2m; synthetic timeout count ~82 in the last 3m across the canary pool (15% rollout). Overall 524 rate ~0.4% for eu1.

ops-ana: Is this widespread across nodes or concentrated? If isolated we can evict those pods from LB and continue with caution.

kevin: Quick per-host scan shows bursts centered on eu1-host-12 and eu1-host-15. Other hosts mostly fine.

release-ivy: Pause rollout. No other batches until we triage.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-ivy.

product-mike: Any customer impact seen? dashboards or support tickets?

tara: No customer alerts yet. We saw a few probe timeouts and two traces from internal QA flows. Risk of further degradation if rollout continues.

sre-lee: Collecting flamegraphs and allocation profiles. Also enabling per-host request tracing for the next 10 minutes.

ops-ana: Recommendation: perform region pin to previous release for eu1 while we debug. Command below (infra-admin required):
```bash
routectl set-route --region eu1 --target release:v2.20.1 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy synth timeouts" --expires 30m
```

kevin: Also suggest temporarily adding host-level conn and accept queue sampling to detect syscalls backpressure.

release-ivy: Approve pin. Ops, go ahead and run the route change.

deploy-bot: Route change queued. Applying... Route change applied: eu1 -> release:v2.20.1 (effective 11:07Z).

kevin: After diversion, synth timeouts dropped back to baseline within 1 minute. No new 524 events reported.

product-mike: Great. Please add a brief note to the release changelog that rollout was paused and eu1 was reverted to stable while we investigate. I'll draft a customer-safe line if needed.

sre-lee: Preliminary traces indicate long blocking in the model-worker event loop on the two hosts; looks like rare blocking GC pauses in the worker process under a specific codepath in the new version. Captured allocation profile attached to ticket.

ops-ana: For immediate safety net, I've quarantined eu1-host-12 and -15 from LB and scheduled rolling restart of their pods. If restarts clear the backlog, we can try a small controlled retry of the rollout.

kevin: Strong follow-up actions: 1) revert region routing (done), 2) host quarantine + restart (done), 3) create INF-4399 to track GC tuning + a small canary with extra observability, 4) add per-host probe sampling to canary checks.

release-ivy: Adding INF-4399 to release actions with severity=high and owner=@kevin. I'll mark the release as "paused - eu1 reverted" in releases dashboard.

deploy-bot: Note recorded in release timeline: paused at 11:07Z due to synth timeouts in eu1; diversion applied to v2.20.1.

product-mike: Thanks team. When we have the GC tuning patch, let's coordinate a re-run during the next low-traffic window and ensure canary size starts at 5% with host-netstat sampling enabled.

kevin: Agreed. I'll put up a small PR with GC tuning flags and a test plan.

release-ivy: Closing this thread for now. Follow-up ticket: INF-4399 (eu1 post-deploy synth timeouts, investigate GC and per-host probe coverage)"
